annotation.title_clean: 公共政策網路參與實施要點
annotation.title_en: Implementation Guidelines for Online Public Policy Participation (Taiwan)
annotation.venue: join.gov.tw 公共政策網路參與平臺
annotation.summary_en: Taiwan Executive Yuan's implementation guidelines for the Public Policy Online Participation Platform (join.gov.tw), covering proposals, 5,000-endorsement threshold, agency responses, policy and draft regulation consultations, and open data. The collected page was meant to be a generative AI guidance draft consultation, but the text is this unrelated procedural document.
key_provisions_or_claims: Citizens or residents can propose policies; proposals need 5,000 endorsements within 60 days.
Agencies must respond to qualifying proposals within two months, extendable by up to two more.
Agencies may consult publicly on major policies and must publish draft laws and regulations for comment.
National Development Council administers the platform; agencies assign supervising officials.
Proposal and consultation data are open, with personal contact data withheld.
